ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across >98% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized strictly to peripheral tips and sparse central dots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white geometric clusters are mapped to the distal left and right tips, with isolated white circular spots located near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 95 degrees; the notch depth is significant relative to the horizontal plane of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by sharp peaks and shallow valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary; serration amplitude is highest near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curve extending from the median notch to the outer tips; the superior boundary of the lobes exhibits a slight convex arc before tapering into the notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial clusters of circular white pixel aggregates located at the distal left and right tips; secondary sparse clusters of 3-5 circular dots are visible near the notch point.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral biological encrustation forming irregular white masses at the distal tips of both lobes.
